dedupe_keys.name: ibge censo 2022 urban surroundings of dwellings caracteristicas urbanisticas do entorno street face infrastructure by census tract

description: During the 2022 census IBGE enumerators recorded what each street face (one side of a block) in the selected urban tracts looks like, and IBGE publishes the result as tract-level counts. For every tract the faces table gives the number of faces by the traffic the street carries (trucks and buses, cars and vans, only pedestrians, bicycles and motorcycles, or waterway), and whether the face has a paved road, a storm drain inlet (bueiro), public lighting, a bus stop, cycle signage, a sidewalk, obstacles on the sidewalk, a wheelchair ramp, and how many trees. Parallel tables count the households and persons living on faces with each feature. The producer is IBGE, which runs the survey of urban surroundings with the census to describe infrastructure around dwellings. Coverage: tracts chosen for the surroundings survey across Brazil, with aggregates to neighbourhoods, districts and municipalities, plus separate files for favelas and urban communities. Format and access: zipped CSV and XLSX files (about 10 to 12 MB per tract file, April 2025) and dictionaries, free on ftp.ibge.gov.br. Licence: not stated in the directory; IBGE's terms page could not be read from the cloud (bot challenge). Caveats: only tracts selected for the surroundings survey are covered, observations are the enumerator's view on the ground, and there are no geometries of individual faces in these files. Simulation uses: gaps in drainage, lighting, paving and pedestrian infrastructure for flood and heat adaptation, accessibility and transit coverage models. Related records: the IBGE 2022 tract aggregates and their boundaries.
